why: The builder brief's commands are fine: `npm test` at the root, and git/PR steps described in plain words. The verifier brief has commands that would not run as written. Check 3 gives `jsonl-lint.js b.jsonl b.jsonl`, `jsonl-lint.js b.jsonl a.jsonl b.jsonl`, `jsonl-lint.js` and `jsonl-lint.js b.jsonl missing.jsonl c.jsonl`. There is no `jsonl-lint.js` on PATH or at the repo root; the script lives at packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js, so these fail as given. The paths also clash. The verifier is told to put fixtures in "a scratch temp directory", but Checks 1–3 use the repo-relative `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js` with bare `a.jsonl`. That only works if the fixtures sit in the repo root, and then they are not in a scratch directory. The `<pr>` and merge-base placeholders are acceptable because the brief says how to fill them. The Check 3 commands still break the criterion.
